newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent diesel prices track NYMEX lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent diesel prices track NYMEX lower.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent diesel fuel prices eased late Friday, tracking lower futures prices on unchanged differentials in quiet trade, traders said.
Unleaded gasoline basis in the Midwest markets was steady on the day, with spot prices modestly lower on easing front-month NYMEX unleaded, traders said.
Spot Group Three and Chicago diesel prices were expected to move lower next week after surging higher this week on a tightened supply-demand balance in the Gulf Coast market, traders said.
"The basis should be walloped," one Group Three trader said.
Group Three low and high sulphur diesel was talked 7.50/7.75 cents a gallon over NYMEX May heating oil for April deliveries, traders said.
Chicago low sulphur was talked 4.50/4.75 cents a gallon over the print and high sulphur was 2.25/2.50 cents over for all April timings, traders said.
Unleaded gasoline was talked 2.0/1.75 cents a gallon under NYMEX May unleaded in Group Three and 0.75/1.0 cents under the print in the Chicago market.
